plan.notes: Official UW-Eau Claire Academic Catalog Computer Science Comprehensive Major B.S. sample degree plan. The published sample plan sums to 121 credits at minimum credit choices (16+14+16+15+15+15+15+15); the published minimum total for the baccalaureate degree is 120 credits. Recorded total_credits=121 equals the exact sum of recorded course credits. Choice slots recorded at minimum: PHYS 212 (4, of 4-5), WRIT 114 (5, Intensive) recorded as the representative writing option, MATH 246 (4) as stats representative. CS electives (12 credits total: 3+6+3; at least 9 at the 300-level or above) chosen from AI 250, AI 350, AI 420, CS 291, CS 330, CS 370, CS 376, CS 388, CS 399, CS 425, CS 426, CS 436, CS 450, CS 455, CS 485, CS 491, CS 498, or other department-designated courses. Unspecified CGER slots recorded as generic placeholders.
